name: Transfar Zhilian Co., Ltd.
summary: Transfar Zhilian Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the chemical and logistics businesses in China and internationally. The company operates through nine segments: Textile Printing and Dyeing Auxiliaries; Butadiene Rubber; Coatings and Construction Chemicals; Online Freight Platform Business; After-Sales Vehicle Business; Logistics Supply Chain Business; Smart Highway Port Business; Payment, Insurance, and Other Services; and Real Estate Sales and Engineering Construction Management.
